scope: Backbone-only evaluation; no latent recurrence experiments
question: First compare fixed sinusoids against ALiBi under original Mitchell initialization; then test selected positions with window2 attention only in RT block2.

model.position: stage1 fixed unit sinusoidal, base10000, origin0, unscaled token embeddings; stage2 selected fixed sinusoidal or ALiBi

objective.state_ce: mean over B*T; same-position A5 states
objective.latent: SmoothL1 beta1 mean over B*(T-1)*D; targetonlydetach

paper_code_discrepancy: A5 code proj_factor0.5 giveshidden512; Table5says1024. Usecode512.

evaluations.aux_diagnostics: bounded teacher-conditioned one-step loss/scale only; no rollout

stop: Finish both authorized 10k pilots, compare, report and retain; no other arms or training extensions.
initialization: Original canonical Mitchell backbone, seed1234, bitwise paired all learned tensors; original predictor seed1235. No identity-centered initialization. Both pilots start fresh.

position_selection.primary: mean cumulative-prefix exactness E(t) over t=13..36 inclusive
position_selection.rationale: A5 length generalization beyond training length12; average E equals expected correct extension length divided by24, with zero contributions after first error. All words included, no conditioning on E12 success.
position_selection.qualification: One-seed development selection; not a confirmed population ranking; confirmation untouched.

keys_at_query_t: temporary self K/V from layer input x_t
permanent previous K/V from layer output z_(t-1), when t>0
window.gradient: full attached recurrence; no detach or truncated BPTT
window.implementation: Fixed additive attention mask in second block, composed with selected positional bias; dense tiled operations retained, no sparse speed claim.

bounded_checks: independent two-record scan vs maskednaive/tiled at smallshapes
preserve temporal recurrent credit and first-token semantics
strict checkpoint resume and endpoint finiteAdam state
pilot_qualification: Two sequential one-seed development pilots at fixed10k, final window comparison against selected full-attention parent with matched initialization/order. No best-checkpoint selection.
